faq: Why do my ad platform and store show different sales?
Common causes are duplicate firing, missing consent, attribution windows and refunds. We check each cause, fix the ones in our control and explain the rest, so you know what difference is normal.
Which conversions should I track first?
The ones that earn money: purchases, then add to cart or lead forms. We suggest a short list during the first day, based on how your store sells, and avoid cluttering reports with minor clicks.
Can you track sales that happen by phone or in person?
Partly. We can track phone link clicks and form leads on the site. Offline sales need your own data uploaded to the ad platform, which Premium can set up as a simple manual process.
Do I need ad accounts to order this?
No. Basic works with Google Analytics alone. For Standard and Premium we need an ad account you own and add us as a standard user. We never ask for your login password.
